name: Midas mHYPER
oneLiner: mHYPER is a Midas NAV-accreting liquid-yield token wrapping Hyperithm market-neutral stablecoin strategies; permissioned mint/redeem, not a fixed $1 peg.
collateral: Hyperithm-managed market-neutral stablecoin strategies across on-chain markets and institutional execution venues, held under Fordefi MPC custody (manager holds the trading key share, Midas holds an admin/policy share). Tokenholders hold a qualified subordinated claim against Midas (no ownership of the underlying assets), secured by a Security Agent lien on the Collateral Account for tokenholders.
pegMechanism: NAV-accreting tokenized debt instrument (blockchain-based certificate under German law), not a fixed $1 peg; value tracks the daily NAV of the Hyperithm-managed market-neutral reference portfolio. Primary mint/redeem only via permissioned Midas DepositVault/RedemptionVault for greenlisted users with NAV conversion settled off-chain by the issuer; instant redemptions are facilitated through Midas Staked Liquidity (MSL). No fixed $1 redemption floor.

proofOfReserves.provider: Midas Attestation Engine: on-chain NAV/proof-of-reserves/price, independently verified via Chainlink, Canary, LlamaRisk and vLayer (launched first on mHYPER)

jurisdiction.regulator: Liechtenstein FMA (prospectus-approving authority only; issuer not FMA-licensed)
jurisdiction.license: EU-Prospectus-Regulation-approved tokenized debt instrument (blockchain-based certificate under German law); EEA-restricted, not available to U.S. retail persons

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes: Midas mHYPER is a permissioned liquid-yield token with issuer/admin control surfaces around minting, redemption, transfer administration, and upgradeable protocol contracts.

mintAuthority.summary: mHYPER is a Midas liquid-yield token; new units are minted only by Midas's permissioned issuance role (MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE) when greenlisted users deposit through the Midas DepositVault, with NAV conversion settled off-chain by the issuer.

controls.label: Midas issuance manager (MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE / DepositVault)
controls.evidence: Midas vault architecture mints the token via a permissioned MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE through the DepositVault against greenlisted deposits; conversion rate is set off-chain by the issuer and token/vault contracts are upgradeable behind MidasAccessControl. Remote-chain supply is bridged from the Ethereum issuance.

review.evidence: Midas liquid-yield tokens are minted and redeemed exclusively through Midas's permissioned DepositVault/RedemptionVault contracts gated by MidasAccessControl roles (greenlist + mint operator); no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists. On-chain owner/role holders not independently read.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the live on-chain MidasAccessControl role holders and the bridge/OFT admin for the Monad/Plasma/Katana deployments before raising confidence.
